# Skills: the script is materialized into scripts/cli-tool-discovery.sh at build time

> Category: **content** · Status:  · Version: 1.0.0

Set up and operate a complete founder content system for a single founder or executive — research and fact layer, voice corpus, rules and ban lists, a gated multi-platform drafting pipeline (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, blog), a day-of reactive track, and a feedback ledger that compounds every correction. Walks the user through collecting any missing inputs (recorded insight call, social handles, reference links, published research, internal docs) before any drafting begins — every input is optional, but every gap is named. Use when onboarding a founder/executive for ghostwritten social content, when asked to 'set up the founder content system for <client>', 'onboard <founder> for LinkedIn/X posts', 'draft a batch of founder posts', 'review a founder content batch', or 'set up the ghostwriting system'. Do NOT trigger on general copywriting, brand marketing campaigns, company-account launch content, paid ad creative, one-off single posts with no system, or non-founder personal blogging.
